authorities.title: Acme Corp. v. Contoso Holdings, 888 F.3d 9 (Fed. Cir. 2098)
authorities.content:
Acme Corp. v. Contoso Holdings, 888 F.3d 9 (Fed. Cir. 2098).

This synthetic opinion is a near-name decoy. It addresses venue transfer under Synthetic Venue Code § 12 and does not discuss preliminary injunctions or irreparable harm.

Held: a motion to transfer venue is granted when the transferee forum is clearly more convenient. No injunction standard is announced.

authorities.title: Synthetic Jurisdiction Code § 101 — Permanent Injunctions
authorities.content:
Synthetic Jurisdiction Code § 101. Permanent injunctions.

(a) A court may grant a permanent injunction only after a trial on the merits and a finding of actual success, not a mere likelihood of success.

(b) This section does not govern preliminary relief under § 100.

authorities.title: Other State Code § 100 — Emergency Stays
authorities.content:
Other State Code § 100. Emergency stays.

A court of Other State may stay enforcement on a showing of substantial hardship. This provision is not a preliminary-injunction standard and does not apply outside Other State.

authorities.title: Synthetic Restatement of Injunctions § 4 (secondary commentary)
authorities.content:
Synthetic Restatement of Injunctions § 4. Commentary only.

Commentators sometimes describe irreparable harm loosely. This restatement is secondary commentary and is not enacted law. It is not a statute and not a judicial holding.
